You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 

Your task is summarize the modifications made in the patch.
Your summary should consist of two parts, modifications in each file and their relationships.

From d3171b6882be50e3bd6ae4cd4c86f9d90a2d8e7a Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Linus Walleij <linus.walleij@linaro.org>
Date: Fri, 12 Feb 2021 09:11:48 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] pinctrl: actions: Add depends on || COMPILE_TEST

I happened to apply the v1 of the patch restriction the
selection to ARM or ARM64, sorry for my sloppiness.
Fixing up the mistake as I can't back the patch out now.

Fixes: 5784921f7b6c ("pinctrl: actions: Add the platform dependency to drivers")
Reviewed-by: Manivannan Sadhasivam <manivannan.sadhasivam@linaro.org>
Signed-off-by: Linus Walleij <linus.walleij@linaro.org>

diff --git a/drivers/pinctrl/actions/Kconfig b/drivers/pinctrl/actions/Kconfig
index 8bb8345b17da..119f0e471efd 100644
--- a/drivers/pinctrl/actions/Kconfig
+++ b/drivers/pinctrl/actions/Kconfig
@@ -12,21 +12,21 @@ config PINCTRL_OWL
 
 config PINCTRL_S500
 	bool "Actions Semi S500 pinctrl driver"
-	depends on ARM
+	depends on ARM || COMPILE_TEST
 	depends on PINCTRL_OWL
 	help
 	  Say Y here to enable Actions Semi S500 pinctrl driver
 
 config PINCTRL_S700
 	bool "Actions Semi S700 pinctrl driver"
-	depends on ARM64
+	depends on ARM64 || COMPILE_TEST
 	depends on PINCTRL_OWL
 	help
 	  Say Y here to enable Actions Semi S700 pinctrl driver
 
 config PINCTRL_S900
 	bool "Actions Semi S900 pinctrl driver"
-	depends on ARM64
+	depends on ARM64 || COMPILE_TEST
 	depends on PINCTRL_OWL
 	help
 	  Say Y here to enable Actions Semi S900 pinctrl driver
-- 
2.25.1

### Modifications in Each File

1. **File: `drivers/pinctrl/actions/Kconfig`**
   - The dependency conditions for three pinctrl drivers (S500, S700, S900) have been modified:
     - For `PINCTRL_S500`, the dependency was changed from `depends on ARM` to `depends on ARM || COMPILE_TEST`.
     - For `PINCTRL_S700`, the dependency was changed from `depends on ARM64` to `depends on ARM64 || COMPILE_TEST`.
     - For `PINCTRL_S900`, the dependency was changed from `depends on ARM64` to `depends on ARM64 || COMPILE_TEST`.

### Relationships

- The modifications in the `Kconfig` file are aimed at broadening the conditions under which the Actions Semi pinctrl drivers can be compiled. By adding `COMPILE_TEST` as an alternative dependency, the drivers can now be built even if the target architecture is not ARM or ARM64, facilitating testing and development across different configurations. This change addresses a previous restriction that limited the selection of these drivers to specific architectures, thus fixing the oversight mentioned in the patch description.

Here is the commit message:
pinctrl: actions: Add depends on || COMPILE_TEST

I happened to apply the v1 of the patch restriction the
selection to ARM or ARM64, sorry for my sloppiness.
Fixing up the mistake as I can't back the patch out now.

Fixes: 5784921f7b6c ("pinctrl: actions: Add the platform dependency to drivers")
Reviewed-by: Manivannan Sadhasivam <manivannan.sadhasivam@linaro.org>
Signed-off-by: Linus Walleij <linus.walleij@linaro.org>

Here is the root cause:
The original configuration for the Actions Semi pinctrl drivers restricted their compilation to only ARM or ARM64 architectures, which limited their usability and testing on other platforms. This oversight was identified as a mistake, necessitating the inclusion of `COMPILE_TEST` to allow for broader compilation options.

Here is the patch:

 	bool "Actions Semi S500 pinctrl driver"
-	depends on ARM
+	depends on ARM || COMPILE_TEST
 	depends on PINCTRL_OWL
 	help
 config PINCTRL_S700
 	bool "Actions Semi S700 pinctrl driver"
-	depends on ARM64
+	depends on ARM64 || COMPILE_TEST
 	depends on PINCTRL_OWL
 	help
 config PINCTRL_S900
 	bool "Actions Semi S900 pinctrl driver"
-	depends on ARM64
+	depends on ARM64 || COMPILE_TEST
 	depends on PINCTRL_OWL
 	help

The code statements that lead to the bug are:
```plaintext
depends on ARM
depends on ARM64
```
Reason:
The original configuration for the Actions Semi pinctrl drivers restricted their compilation to only ARM or ARM64 architectures. This limitation prevented the drivers from being compiled and tested on other platforms, which was an oversight that needed correction.

The code statements that fix the bug are:
```plaintext
depends on ARM || COMPILE_TEST
depends on ARM64 || COMPILE_TEST
```
Reason:
By modifying the dependencies to include `COMPILE_TEST`, the patch allows the pinctrl drivers to be compiled on platforms other than ARM or ARM64, thus broadening their usability and enabling testing across different architectures.
